Agent Name: Blu-Ray_Expert
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: They assumed the Platform values were in the 'Platform' column and dropped all rows with NaN in that column. In this sheet, platform categories appear as section headers in the 'Title' column (e.g., “Blu-Ray”, “DVD”) and must be propagated to subsequent rows (e.g., via forward-fill) to correctly label items. Dropping NaNs emptied the dataset for Blu-Ray and led to the incorrect conclusion that no Blu-Ray entries existed, missing the correct oldest title “Time-Parking 2: Parallel Universe.”
